method_note: A first pass searched only for markdown headings and concluded six requirements were undefined. That was wrong: definitions take three forms. The corrected method searches all three. This is recorded because the method, not the number, is what a later reader needs.

requirement_register.consequence: There is no single requirement register. Definitions live in the factory plan as headings and in decision records as prose. Any Wave 2 inventory must search all forms or it will under-count, and a requirement register may itself be a Wave 2 candidate.

SF-REQ-051.note: Agent-Ready extension for design existence/verification is explicitly 'not built now'.

SF-REQ-053.note: Phase 6 records the coordinator tenure and checkpoint as unreplaced; LRN-027 establishes no handover was ever exercised.

SF-REQ-056.note: SWF-29 names it as the capability whose arrival expires the bootstrap watcher, and narrows what it must do, but no definition sentence specifies it. Phase 6 made SWF-29 KEEP_UNTIL_REPLACED on exactly this basis. Specifying it in Phase 8 is therefore writing the requirement, not restating one -- a boundary the Director may not cross silently.

SF-REQ-039.text: Support deterministic scripted/fake workers that exercise the real factory lifecycle without provider credentials or token spend.
